items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队车手安东内利感谢团队在墨西哥城大奖赛中的努力，尽管连续两天更换引擎，但车队从未错过任何练习。

items.originalTitle: "I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a se...
items.summaryEn:
"I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a session, so that’s a great effort." 🗣️ AK
Saturday wrapped up in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
“我想感谢团队所有人的辛勤工作和努力，因为我们在这短短的时间内两天都进行了引擎更换，并且从未错过任何一节练习，这是巨大的努力。” 🗣️ AK
周六在墨西哥城结束 🇲🇽
#哈斯F1 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
"I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a session, so that’s a great effort." 🗣️ AK
Saturday wrapped up in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
